prelude: struct S { int a; int b; constexpr S() : a(1) {} };

rows.return a named local: constexpr S make() { S s; return s; }
rows.return a parenthesized local: constexpr S make() { S s; return (s); }
rows.return a local through a conditional: constexpr S make() { S s; return true ? s : s; }
rows.return a local after setting every part: constexpr S make() { S s; s.b = 2; return s; }

cols.a local initialized from make():
constexpr int read() { S t = make(); return t.a; }
static_assert(read() == 1);
